verdict.rationale: First-party Relay Proxy docs state that LaunchDarkly exposes a streaming API that is proxied to clients. Independent users confirm that SDKs download all flags on connect, then stream changes via server-sent events with no added network latency. Together these clearly deliver the core of real-time flag propagation. Missing for 10: first-party SDK docs quantifying propagation latency ("seconds"), documentation of a fast-polling fallback mode, and explicit kill-switch documentation or a hands-on report of one taking effect.
